summary: Retest of the new auto-open-preview cashier flow and the receipt Print routing. All 6 requested checks PASSED. Preview auto-opens on /receipts/:id?print=1 with correct real data, geometry is exactly 210x142.8mm (scrollHeight 142.35mm, no clipping), rv-print-direct shows the inline 'not yet available on this build' error without triggering window.print or navigation, Cancel closes the modal, the toolbar rv-print (no ?print=1) opens the same preview modal (never window.print), Settings 'Print Test Receipt' opens the preview with SAMPLE data (TEST STUDENT, AMOUNT RECEIVED) while URL stays on /settings, and receipts count remains 1 (no new receipts created).

test_results.auto_open_preview_with_print_1: PASS - modal opened, contains SEC-2026-000001, Aaradhya, TUITION FEE 4,500, ADMISSION FEE 1,000, TOTAL 5,500, AMOUNT RECEIVED, AMOUNT IN WORDS, title mentions 210 x 142.8 mm landscape (A5 media)
test_results.geometry_210x142.8: PASS - width=210.00mm, height=142.80mm, scrollHeight=142.35mm (<=142.8), no clipping, no 2nd page
test_results.rv_print_direct_inline_error: PASS - window.print NOT called, URL unchanged, modal contains 'not yet available on this build', modal stays open, Cancel closes modal
test_results.rv_print_toolbar_opens_preview: PASS - without ?print=1 modal does NOT auto-open; clicking [data-testid=rv-print] opens receipt-print-preview; window.print NOT called
test_results.settings_test_print_sample_data: PASS - saved printer name, clicked Print Test Receipt, preview opened with TEST STUDENT + AMOUNT RECEIVED, URL remained /settings
test_results.no_new_receipts: PASS - GET /api/receipts count = 1 (unchanged from seeded SEC-2026-000001)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows working. Note: to log in as admin from Playwright you must POST http://localhost:8001/api/auth/login via bash and inject the token into localStorage.setItem('bc_token', <token>) with add_init_script BEFORE navigation - remote /api/auth/login is 403 for admin by design.
